title: NWIS Intelligence Record
description: Version 0.1.0 intelligence record. Contains anomaly score, risk level, alert status, explainable evidence, and quality flags. Computed from M0.4 feature records. Risk thresholds and weights are documented prototype parameters only — not engineering standards.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. Propagated from canonical record.

well_id.description: NWIS internal well identifier. Preserved from canonical/feature record.

source_row_index.description: Source row index. Preserved for full traceback.

data_origin.description: Provenance class. Preserved from canonical record.

telemetry_status.description: Telemetry status. Preserved from canonical record.

intelligence_status.description: Whether intelligence was computed. SUPPRESSED: quality gate blocked scoring (e.g. EMPTY record). DEGRADED: score computed but confidence reduced (e.g. source gap). SCORED: normal computation.

anomaly_score.description: Composite anomaly score 0–100. Null if SUPPRESSED. PROTOTYPE: thresholds are not validated engineering standards.

risk_level.description: Risk level derived from anomaly_score. PROTOTYPE thresholds: NORMAL 0-30, WATCH 30-60, ELEVATED 60-80, HIGH 80-100. Null if SUPPRESSED.

alert.description: True only after the anomaly persists across the configured debounce window. A single anomalous sample does not trigger an alert.

confidence.description: Score confidence 0–1. Reflects feature coverage and source quality. Null if SUPPRESSED.

evidence.description: Ordered list of top contributing features. Empty if SUPPRESSED or NORMAL with no meaningful contributions.

direction.description: Direction of the anomaly relative to baseline.

contribution.description: Fraction of total anomaly score from this feature (0–1).

z_score.description: Robust z-score (deviation from rolling median in units of MAD). Provided for interpretability.

quality_flags.description: Machine-readable quality flags explaining any degradation or suppression.

suppressed_empty.description: True if record was suppressed because telemetry_status == EMPTY.

source_gap_suppression.description: True if anomaly score was capped due to source gap adjacency.

low_coverage.description: True if fewer than 50% of the intelligence model features were available.

insufficient_baseline.description: True if the rolling baseline had fewer than 3 observations (early records).

available_feature_count.description: Number of intelligence model features that were non-null for this record.

baseline_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the rolling baseline values used to produce this record's score. Included for auditability. Null if SUPPRESSED.

_prototype_thresholds.note: All thresholds are prototype parameters for the NWIS MVP. They have not been validated against confirmed drilling events or engineering standards.
